requirements.text: Hub/history filters subject and safe body substring, linked context, lifecycle and reachable email channel; bounded page/limit ≤100 and safe fallback for invalid read filters. Available filters reflect all authorized history. Totals distinguish selected, reachable, attempted, accepted, delivered, engaged, failed and unknown; zero denominator is safe. Load failure shows unavailable.
requirements.title: Communication hub, filtered history and delivery overview

behavior_rules.rule: Supported statuses values: draft, scheduled, accepted, failed, unknown, cancelled, sent.
Visible information for plant_owner|plant_admin|plant_member: message id, selected, reachable, attempted, accepted, sent, delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, failed, suppressed, unknown, as of.
Exact operation-specific parent IDs/joins and visible denominator; deliverability/lifecycle/best engagement remain distinct and unknown never counts as sent/contacted.
Visible information for plant_owner|plant_admin|plant_member: items, next cursor, visible count, as of, completeness.
Bounded scoped history/search; draft listing always enforces draft state server-side, filters cannot change it. State is aggregate projection over one mail ledger.
Supported states values: draft, scheduled, sending, sent, logged, cancelled, failed, unknown.
Supported provider outcomes values: accepted, delivered, transient_refusal, permanent_refusal, bounced, suppressed, unknown.

requirements.text: Detail and Person/meeting histories require same-plant parent and child constraints. Show the frozen delivery-time subject/address/body facts and separately label current contact/context facts. Recipient outcomes/timestamps stay attributable. Deleted/gone parent yields not found.
requirements.title: Message detail, recipient and person/meeting communication histories

behavior_rules.rule: Visible information for plant_owner|plant_admin|plant_member: items, next cursor, meeting id.
Visible information for plant_owner|plant_admin|plant_member: items, next cursor, person id.

Visible information for plant_owner|plant_admin|plant_member: communication id, revision, state, subject, body, audience counts, attachment metadata, provider outcomes, source references, completeness.
Operation requires its one exact communication/draft/execution parent; does not require unrelated message ids or allow cross-domain execution receipt selection.
Visible information for plant_owner|plant_admin|plant_member: items, next cursor, message id, completeness.
Visible information for plant_owner|plant_admin|plant_member: items, next cursor, message id, meeting id, completeness.

requirements.text: Compose/preview subject 1–500 characters, nonempty safe rendered body and at least one reachable reviewed recipient for sending. Sanitize stored HTML and derive plain text from it; merge Person/plant/meeting fields using the same renderer for preview and dispatch. Reject malformed JSON and foreign template/meeting IDs before persistence. No SMS/both dispatch.
requirements.title: Compose and preview sanitized rich-text email with merge fields

behavior_rules.rule: Preview resolves current approved per-recipient merge fields and ready owned attachments; no intents/provider effects. Server freezes whole exact audience; batching≤100 per HTTP request, not total recipient truncation.
Supported group values: core_group, launch_team, leaders, prospects, all.
One current exact active plant Owner/Admin; every referenced parent/child same plant; lifecycle/revision rechecked at commit.
Exact canonical actor/subject/purpose guard applies at call and commit; alias introduces no extra grant or stale scope.

Review/execution binds server-frozen whole audience/per-recipient bytes/attachments/source versions, not arbitrary model addresses/bytes. Recheck current recipients/exclusions; one ledger commits all intents then bounded exact-scope batches.
Aggregate current projection exposes sending/partial/accepted/delivered/failed/unknown truth; accepted is not delivery/contact.

requirements.text: Search first 20 results; closed groups core_group/launch_team/leaders/prospects/all and active/forming team IDs resolve the whole group, deduplicate Person IDs and show missing-email exclusions. Unknown selector resolves zero. Recruitment groups exclude account-seat cohort as specified by People. Re-resolve at review/handoff rather than truncate to search pagination.
requirements.title: Recipient search and closed quick-select groups

behavior_rules.rule: Only actual active/forming same-plant team selectors; no address list or generic nullable person/meeting selector.
Resolve whole selected approved group/team/people set; unknown selector zero, never all; current exclusions/dedup/recruitment-account exclusions visible, no 100-total-audience cap.
First 20 recipient search only, no implicit whole-audience truncation.

requirements.text: Dispatch exact frozen per-recipient payloads with one truthful delivery history; correlate ordered batches of at most 100 by intent ID, apply suppression/current handoff checks, and retain accepted/rejected/unknown facts separately. A short result array or exception never marks all recipients sent. Unknown acceptance reconciles with the same frozen provider key within its retention window and blocks blind new-key replay afterward.
requirements.title: Bulk provider dispatch and per-recipient outcome correlation

behavior_rules.rule: Supported provider outcomes values: accepted, delivered, rejected, bounced, suppressed, unknown.

Whole immutable exact-scope request manifest≤100 owns one stable provider key; current fenced attempt selects existing frozen bytes/key, never caller regrouping or per-intent key. First-dispatch cutoff 23h 55m never resets; unknown beyond retention reconciles only.
Accepted/sent email cannot be recalled; unknown acceptance reconciled before retry; no duplicate replacement provider key.

Registered owning-domain adapter/job only, with verified source occurrence/receipt and exact typed scope. Fresh domain authorization remains evaluated; no model/direct HTTP invocation or arbitrary event/recipient/executor RPC.
Verified source receipt/current registered type and actual stored current authorization, never supplied actor/proof IDs.

requirements.text: Compose and resend return confirmed zero-provider-acceptance as failure with saved communication ID and sentAt null; partial results show exact accepted/rejected/unknown counts. An all-unknown result is uncertain rather than success, and missing provider IDs remain reconcilable.
requirements.title: Truthful provider rejection in the composer

requirements.text: Browse global system and same-plant templates. Owner/Admin communication writers create/update same-plant email templates and fork global templates once per plant/source identity. Name 1–255, description ≤1000, subject ≤500, nonempty sanitized body; unchanged reviewed state on edit. System originals are immutable to plant writers. Archive referenced templates; delete an unreferenced fork may reveal current global source.

behavior_rules.rule: Only own-plant fork/custom template; referenced historical template content stays available by saved frozen source/version and archived-name fallback.
Supported requested action values: archive, delete.
Own-plant bounded email template create/edit/global-source fork, immutable global source and one preference by source identity; unchanged reviewed state for edit, no caller-minted new ID.

requirements.title: System and church message-template CRUD and copy-on-write forks

requirements.text: Seven approved system message templates have stable source/revision IDs and category/meeting-type mapping. Fork preference is by source identity. Bootstrap repeat-equal is no-op; mismatch never overwrites a plant customization. Installation uses reference release.

behavior_rules.rule: Visible information for plant_owner|plant_admin|plant_member: templates, source ids, versions, meeting type mappings, completeness.
Stable global source identity and current own-plant fork preference; exact template or meeting/type selector, no all-null ambiguity/global source mutation.

requirements.title: Canonical message-template bootstrap and meeting invitation selection

requirements.text: Resend proposal requires sent original, ≥24 elapsed hours, ≥1 confirmed delivery and currently deliverable delivered non-openers. Click/open exclude; missing/deleted/suppressed recipients exclude. Present unreliable tracking caveat and exact exclusions. New communication retains frozen original delivery content and lineage; review current permitted recipient substitutions rather than silently remerge. Original remains unchanged.
requirements.title: Reviewed resend to delivered non-openers

behavior_rules.rule: Reviewed distinct deliberate resend/recovery operation rechecks source, ownership, confirmed delivery≥24h/nonopener or authoritative failure as applicable; never invent negative acceptance evidence or retry unknown with new key.
Delivered-nonopener resend requires ≥24h after sent original, ≥1 confirmed delivery, no open/click and current deliverability. Proven failed recovery distinct; unknown not candidate.
Supported selection values: delivered_nonopeners, proven_failed.

requirements.text: Random purpose-bound public RSVP token is scoped to one real same-plant Person/meeting, normally expires after seven days and has one live pending identity per pair. GET displays, explicit POST confirms/declines. The answer and canonical meeting response succeed or fail together; scanner fetch never answers. Expired pending renewal preserves answered history. Token answer affects RSVP/engagement, never attendance/commitment/contact.

behavior_rules.rule: Already included in exact reviewed invitation/send action

requirements.title: Public token RSVP and email engagement linkage

requirements.text: Save/reload/edit/delete incomplete native email drafts in the existing communication aggregate with conflict detection/history and no mail intent. Review exact audience/per-recipient safe content/Instant before Resend API scheduling within 30 days. Reviewed time-only update preserves content; content/audience replacement waits for confirmed cancellation of all affected original sends. Sent/unknown/partial cancellation blocks automatic replacement. SMS/inbound/custom beyond-window scheduling are excluded.
requirements.title: Native drafts and reviewed scheduled email

behavior_rules.rule: Delete only unsent draft under unchanged reviewed state; cannot cancel provider intent or erase sent history.
Native draft may be incomplete; closed create/edit revision path; saving never schedules/sends or creates mail attempt.
All composition fields may be empty/absent while draft; no provider intent
Cancel each relevant original scheduled provider intent; sent/unknown remain factual, success only confirmed canceled. Cancel request alone is not cancellation proof.
Create reviewed replacement only after authoritative confirmed cancellation of every relevant original intent. Sent/partial/unknown blocks replacement; no duplicate delivery from uncertain cancel.
Supported dst choice values: unambiguous, earlier, later.
Time-only reschedule original frozen provider scheduled recipients; no content/audience replacement and no claim all changed on partial/unknown response.
Schedule exact reviewed frozen complete draft and timezone/DST provenance; provider confirmed window≤30 days, partial/unknown truthful.

requirements.text: One inbox and preferences page preserve own visible feed, unread/pagination, individual/all read and category/channel choices; foreign recipients denied and read never completes work.

Ordinary eligible categories resolve email+in-app ON, except planter digest defaults email ON/in-app OFF; retain that no-duplicate-summary exception until an explicit user channel choice; preserve chosen values through audience changes and never broaden recipient eligibility.

Password/security/invitation purpose mail remains separate from optional category toggles; existing purpose checks, token secrecy and global address suppression still apply. Preserve Discovery receipts under their existing exact recipient/purpose/preference behavior, without a blanket mandatory relationship-mail rule.
Planter weekly Sunday 16:00 church-local email default, daily option and no duplicate inbox digest; existing date/time rules and one logical period are retained.
Organization daily oversight sends only current-authorized relevant activity; its frequency and channels are adjustable. No hidden/unshared/private-care inputs or empty activity mail.
After a multi-day outage deliver a bounded consolidated dated catch-up of still-authorized relevant activity/current open items, never individual stale-day piles or obsolete task/meeting reminders.
Meeting/task cancellation, completion or rescheduling stops obsolete pending reminders; normal current state/audience checks remain before external send.

Preserve the original reviewed mail and its outcome/correlation, bounded retry, truthful unknown outcomes, signed callback processing and suppression. Never blindly resend an acceptance timeout or acknowledge away an unpersisted callback.

Small explicit types include actual implemented producers and already accepted notices; unused category/helpers create no new team-health/training/assessment/NeedsYou/Home/snooze alert or configurable rules engine.

UI and existing Evry notification adapters share recipient-scoped operations. Own reviewed mark-read preserves read/work separation; revoked/foreign scopes denied, private care excluded and each durable Evry write exactly reviewed.
Save/reload/update/delete incomplete same-tenant native draft with conflict detection/history; no provider call/queued send or template overwrite.

Review exact resolved recipients/addresses/sanitized per-recipient payload and Instant before native schedule handoff; stale source/authority requires new review, schedule acceptance is not sent/delivered.
Schedule through Resend native API within 30 days including supported batch; no SMTP scheduling or custom long-horizon queue. Church-local display/ISO Instant uses accepted entered-DST rules.
Time-only rescheduling preserves recipient/content snapshot and original send request; uses a separate reviewed operation and truthful provider confirmation/unknown outcome.
Cancel pending native scheduled email and reconcile result. Content/audience replacement waits for confirmed old cancellation; sent/unknown/partial cancellation cannot silently create duplicates.

Correlate each batch recipient provider ID/outcome, preserve frozen keys/payload and distinguish scheduled/accepted/sent/delivered/rejected/unknown/canceled receipts using documented provider responses/events.
After provider handoff, ordinary material authority/address/suppression changes request native cancellation/reconciliation; do not claim application reauthorization at provider send time.
Communication detail/person/meeting/history reads expose actual draft/scheduled/cancel/reschedule receipts only to current authorized readers; no unrelated private-care or token leakage.

Existing Evry composition/recipe adapters add draft save and reviewed schedule/reschedule/cancel/replacement through the same domain operations; each durable effect exactly reviewed and no autonomous send.

Every published global change behind customized organization content creates a safe current-editor in-app review cue, including typo-only; inherited untouched article follows current global publication. Publisher meaningful-reader flag never suppresses editor notice.

Named Wiki upstream-editor notice is in-app ONLY; no mail intent/provider send even with category email ON. Current exact own-org editor role/safe source access and no private care remain; no automatic adoption/read reset.

Use existing approved native Church Documents save/import/read/storage for plant values/guides/internal writing under current authority; preserve existing plant-local Wiki read through authorized source view, without adding a Wiki authoring or precedence grant.

All outgoing mail has one truthful delivery history. Preserve the exact reviewed per-recipient payload, address, request identity, ordered audience and original first-dispatch instant with a truthful outcome. Provider latency cannot hold up unrelated changes. A batch≤100 has one stable whole-request identity and exact ownership/projection scope, singleton account-private/security unless identically permitted.10 second call timeout. At handoff recheck active subject/current authority/audience/source/suppression. Keep acceptance/sent/delivery/engagement/cancellation/unknown distinct. Lost/reclaimed acceptance reconciles identical request/key only before first dispatch+23h55m within documented 24h protection; no retry clock reset or blind fresh-key replay afterward.

behavior_rules.rule: Authoritative exact request/intent observation reconciles truthful unknown, preserves first-dispatch/cutoff and never silently resends uncertain accepted request.

requirements.text: Typed plant or exact organization anchor, recipient and paired entity identity; one live occurrence key, renewed occurrence after cancellation only when legitimate. Commit only currently eligible category/audience. No generic unchecked organization UUID.
requirements.title: Tenant/organization anchored enqueue and deduplicated delivery intent

behavior_rules.rule: Operation-specific mandatory current source occurrence/parent/revision; trusted owning producer derives audience/category/channel. No nullable universal event bag; Wiki upstream notice in_app-only, actual Discovery receipts target account+valid exact org Owners with no phantom plant.

Supported registered category values: task_due, task_overdue, meeting_announcement, meeting_reminder, planter_digest, oversight_digest, relationship_milestone, sharing_milestone, phase_milestone, launch_milestone, wiki_upstream_review.

requirements.text: Due claim, generation fence, timeout/backoff, cancellation, unknown reconciliation follow execution; fairness tuning belongs to G-LOAD; mail preserves one truthful delivery history. Recipient, current preference, live subject/entity and sharing are rechecked at dispatch.
requirements.title: Atomic channel dispatcher, batching, backoff and live-subject cancellation

behavior_rules.rule: Bounded registered claim/dispatch/reconcile/recovery protocol, exact attempt/manifest/current generation; DB clock proves expired lease, no client outcome/provider key or unknown new-key resend.
Persisted job_state ready|claimed|retry_wait|reconcile|succeeded|failed|cancelled|superseded; pending/completed/blocked_unknown are projection aliases only.

requirements.text: Self feed/unread/bell show only due visible uncanceled entries under current grants; deterministic bounded pagination, unread filter, individual mark and mark-all-visible use identical predicates. Future/foreign/revoked entries and their counts are hidden. Read does not complete work. Empty differs from unavailable.
requirements.title: In-app notification feed, unread filters, pagination and bell

behavior_rules.rule: Feed pure query of due/current eligible/uncanceled visible entries; keyset predicate identical to unread/mark commands, no implicit mark or successful business mutation.

Supported categories values: task_due, task_overdue, meeting_announcement, meeting_reminder, planter_digest, oversight_digest, relationship_milestone, sharing_milestone, phase_milestone, launch_milestone, wiki_upstream_review.
Re-evaluate same due/current visibility predicate and reviewed cutoff; do not mark newly arrived/future/revoked entries implicitly.
Mark only own due currently eligible visible entry; read does not complete linked work.
Mark exact owned selected visible entries under current predicate, no foreign existence.
Unread pure scalar count uses same due/current visibility predicate; no page/mark side effect or hidden foreign/future count.
The notification recipient is the trusted authenticated account and cannot be selected by the caller.

requirements.text: Own category/channel explicit choices, planter cadence/local schedule and organization oversight cadence use small closed inputs and unchanged reviewed state. Only actual producers appear as enabled functionality. No custom rules, arbitrary schedules, snooze or alert families.
requirements.title: User category/channel preferences with explicit-choice intent

behavior_rules.rule: Own planter digest frequency daily/weekly only for currently eligible actual plant recipient; OFF is own channel choice, not a cadence or arbitrary schedule builder.
Supported cadence values: daily, weekly.
Current exact actual plant recipient required for planter cadence; Discovery can change own categories but not fabricate planter digest.
Authenticated own actual producer choices incl explicit equal-default choices; no phantom seat and no custom rule builder.
Explicit trusted reviewed save persists even default-equal value; actual categories only, Wiki editor notice in_app only, cannot enlarge audience/change unrelated cadence/channel choices.

Supported category values: task_due, task_overdue, meeting_announcement, meeting_reminder, planter_digest, oversight_digest, relationship_milestone, sharing_milestone, phase_milestone, launch_milestone, wiki_upstream_review.
Supported channel values: email, in_app.

requirements.text: Task due and one-calendar-day overdue reminder uses current assignee/due revision. Complete/delete/reassign/reschedule invalidates old occurrence and creates applicable replacement intent transactionally. Current task and recipient checked at send.
requirements.title: Task due/overdue reminders and reminder cancellation/resync

requirements.text: Scheduled meeting announcement to linked eligible core-group accounts; 7/3/1 day-offset reminders to eligible linked attendance/guest-list accounts plus creator. Edit cancels/rebuilds; canceled/completed/past meetings suppress obsolete reminders. CRM bulk guest invitations use Communication, not another address fallback.
requirements.title: Meeting scheduled and day-offset reminders

behavior_rules.rule: Internal actual meeting producer only: linked eligible account cohort/creator and live attendance/guest-list rules; not generic CRM-address fallback/model recipient-account lookup.
Supported reminder kind values: scheduled_announcement, day_7, day_3, day_1.

requirements.text: Nonempty authorized planter open-items digest contains overdue/due-before-next-period tasks and upcoming meetings. Current assignee scope and church-local period determine count; one logical recipient period. Catch-up consolidates current items and real dates.
requirements.title: Planter open-items daily/weekly digest and church local send schedule

behavior_rules.rule: Shared church-local weekly day/hour only, default Sunday 16; own recipient cadence/channel independent; unchanged reviewed state and timezone/schedule preview binds future changes.
Reviewed-state correction or explicit no-op history; unknown external effects require reconciliation.
Preview actual currently eligible self planter current church-local period/owed catch-up, server interval/current assignment; never caller-selected recipient or send.
Require actual current plant digest audience and exact current plant context; counts restricted by current assignment/read predicate.

requirements.text: Exact organization oversight digest contains permitted activity counts and dates, no names/notes/message bodies/giving. Period uses the organization's saved IANA zone, default UTC when absent, displayed in preferences. Current approved relationship plus activity sharing gates each plant contribution at compile and dispatch. Two affiliates never share permission state. Empty activity sends nothing.
requirements.title: Oversight privacy-preserving daily activity digest

behavior_rules.rule: Actual exact recipient/context owed period computed server-side; consolidate uncovered periods into≤100 lines/current actionable authorized facts, coverage advances only matching committed intent/receipt; empty no send.
Exact own-organization eligible self recipient changes cadence; never plant role, foreign org, arbitrary timezone/local schedule or reset independent channel preference.
Exact current organization/self overview from current sharing-approved direct plants only; own saved org zone/default utc, no arbitrary interval/plant actor/names/notes/giving/body.
Supported period values: current, owed_catchup.

requirements.text: Existing relationship/sharing facts and actual phase advance/launch milestones fan out once per occurrence. Declaration/backward phase movement is not advance. Relationship-ending notice can state its own committed event to the affected plant without reopening departed private data. Ordinary current Owner/Admin eligible notice audiences replace title-derived authority.
requirements.title: Relationship, sharing, phase and launch milestone fanout

requirements.text: Verify signed raw-body provider event before lookup, persist unique event ID and processing state before 2xx, retry non 2xx on storage failure, and apply out-of-order facts idempotently without regression. Unknown provider IDs are durably available for reconciliation; no public tenant selector. Soft bounce differs from hard/complaint, whose address suppression remains global.
requirements.title: Signed delivery webhooks for notifications and bulk communication

behavior_rules.rule: Route verifies raw signature/timestamp before lookup; durable unique event/raw-body hash committed before 2xx, unknown message ID retained for reconciliation. Outbound payload hash is different.
Verified event insertion commits durably before success acknowledgement; storage failure returns retryable non-2xx. No provider-selected tenant authorization.
Read durable verified event and actual provider-message mapping; apply event facts idempotently by event time. No arbitrary supplied intent/outcome/provider key.

requirements.text: Normalize addresses and keep one active hard-bounce/complaint suppression with attributed restoration history. Fresh authenticated self-address proof plus reason and exact review can clear only the current account address. Dispatch uses suppression across all shared mail purposes; clearing cannot resurrect canceled mail or grant another address.
requirements.title: Global address suppression and self-service restoration history

behavior_rules.rule: Only current authenticated self address state; no address search/list or another account existence.
Only verified provider hard-bounce/complaint fact; normalized address derives protected existing event/intent, not client selector.

requirements.text: Category email opt-out leaves in-app untouched. Purpose-bound authenticated-encryption token: disable 180 days, separate undo one hour. GET confirms; explicit POST changes. Wrong/expired purpose fails closed; provider one-click POST uses RFC8058. Versioned key ring retains decrypt-only old keys through valid token lifetime; dedicated production key never cron-secret fallback. Opt-out does not invent CRM marketing consent.
requirements.title: Category email unsubscribe, one-click opt-out and bounded undo

behavior_rules.rule: Email opt-out requires an explicit native request bound to the opt-out purpose.

requirements.text: Protected transactional HTML/plain-text templates use recoverable delivery with bounded timeout/idempotency/outcome reconciliation. Domain issuer fixes purpose/address/token, not arbitrary Evry inputs. Security/invitation purposes are separate from optional preference toggles; credentials/tokens/body/address stay out of logs/context.
requirements.title: Protected security and invitation mail

behavior_rules.rule: Pure internal rendering of registered-purpose frozen intent; secret tokens/addresses are protected operational payload, never model/log/audit output.
Dispatch existing fenced immutable full request exactly once-logically under one shared provider key; no arbitrary template/recipient/key inputs or second transport ledger.

requirements.text: Published global change behind organization customization produces an in-app-only notice to current own-org Owner/Admin editors. Email preferences cannot enable email for this notice. Every published upstream change, including typo-only, qualifies; it never adopts/overwrites/hides/unhides or forces a deadline. Unused team welcome/health/training/communication/assessment-ready helpers remain excluded as producers.
requirements.title: Declared notification producers and unused email helpers

requirements.text: Winning Discovery association acceptance/decline/departure/removal occurrence creates transactional-purpose receipts to the Discovery account and valid owners of that exact organization, deduplicated by recipient. Seatless account needs no phantom plant/inbox. Admin title alone does not add a receipt recipient. Commit association/history first with required durable mail intent; rendering/refusal does not undo the association.
requirements.title: Discovery relationship notices

behavior_rules.rule: Internal association producer/authorized operator receipt inspection; no invented general plant-seat customer retry console or token/address exposure.
Fenced existing ledger retry only actual authoritative refusal or identical-key allowed window; unknown reconciles, caller cannot supply a new provider key/recipient.
